description: Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable property in Kataragama, Kataragama D/S Division, Monaragala District for the constructions under Kataragama Sewerage Project
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public project. It specifically authorizes the acquisition of an immovable property (land) for the construction of a pump-house as part of the Kataragama Sewerage Project. The document includes detailed land description, boundaries, survey plan numbers, and extent of the property. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and references the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, the core subject matter is land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
